text:
maria: Heads-up: 62 webinar signups in the last 3 hours that never reached an AE. HubSpot shows owner = blank. SLA (first-touch) breached for ~18 of them.

josh: Oof. Any commonalities? source=webinar_apr29?

maria: Mostly webinar_apr29 + trial-tryit. The HS workflow relies on "company.domain" to exist. Many signups used corporate aliases but Clearbit enrichment returned empty or timed out.

liam: Seeing it in the saleslogs too. The Salesforce upsert is skippng owner because owner_id is null, so the lead becomes unassigned in SF.

ana: Quick mitigation: set a short-term owner in HS workflow -> assign to marketing-triage queue (round-robin across ops team). Also create a task for SDR to claim within 30m.

josh: +1. Let's make the fallback auto-assign for only 20 minutes, then escalate to oncall AE if still unclaimed. Keeps SLA tight.

liam: Also propose changing our enrichment lambda: if clearbit returns null OR we detect free-email (gmail/yahoo/outlook), then extract domain from "company_field" (hidden form input) or fallback to parsing email domain and set property "derived.company_domain". Then let workflow use derived.company_domain OR clearbit.

maria: Good call. Draft HubSpot conditional we'll deploy:

--- HubSpot condition ---
If: company.domain is known OR derived.company_domain is known OR email NOT matches /@(gmail|yahoo|hotmail|outlook)
Then: Assign owner via salesops/robin-service (sticky round-robin)
Else: Set contact property temporary_owner = "marketing-triage" and add task "Claim lead - 20m SLA"
--- end ---

liam: For the round-robin, ensure robin-service persists last_index in secrets (Vault) and respects blackout windows in timezone. josh can we confirm?

josh: Yes, I'll validate robin-service sticky write path today. Will also add a small test to simulate concurrent assigns.

marketing-bot: Runbook note: /runbooks/inbound-lead-handoff v2 created. Owner: liam. ETA: 30m.

ana: Backfill plan: pull contacts created since 2026-04-28T00:00:00Z where owner is blank and source ~ webinar_apr29|trial-tryit, then re-run through the hs->assign workflow. Backfill curl (internal):

curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/ops/lead-reprocess" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"from":"2026-04-28T00:00:00Z","sources":["webinar_apr29","trial-tryit"],"owner_fallback":"marketing-triage"}'

josh: I'll run the backfill in dry-run mode first (limit=50). If results look good, full run after 9pm PST.

liam: Also adding lambda retry: attempt x3 with jittered backoff (200ms, 500ms, 1s) for Clearbit; if still null, set derived.company_domain and proceed. I'll add metric: enrichment_retry.success and enrichment_final.null_rate.

salesops-bot: Pager created: #lead-handoff - if unowned leads > 25 in 15m -> page @sales-oncall.

maria: Action items: 1) josh validate robin-service sticky writes + run dry backfill (today) 2) liam change enrichment lambda to derive domain + retries (tomorrow morning) 3) ana update HubSpot workflow to use derived.company_domain + temporary_owner logic (tonight, dry-run) 4) marketing runbook owner liam to monitor metrics and report in #marketing-sla.

josh: Will post status in 30m.

maria: Thanks team. Will close thread once the workflow dry-run is green and backfill scheduled. :sparkles:
